status: complete locally; all 48 tasks published and all 96 question/solution images visually inspected
selectionReview: Attempt SIX QUESTIONS is whole-examination selection; every task in all eight questions is retained, without duplicating six-question exam bundles.
All roots, solutions, terms, graph read-offs, real parameters and proof steps are mandatory. No finite task-internal choose-one pool.
Published alternative methods are accepted ways to solve one task, not extra practice questions or marks.
markingRules: Mathematical errors/omissions lose 3; numerical slips and permitted misreadings lose 1.
Relevant work earns at least the specified attempt award; worthless work earns 0. No marks strictly between zero and the attempt floor.
Detailed task rules override general deductions: Q2(c)(ii) and the two Q4(c) steps have explicit award lists.
Accept the best of two or more attempts unless specified otherwise; the same error in a section is penalised once.
Full original solutions, alternatives, source inconsistencies and task-specific caps remain beside the score controls.

tasks.questionText: When Katie had travelled 140 km, she had completed 4/9 of her journey. Find the length of her journey.

tasks.questionText: Show, by division, that x − 1 is a factor of f(x).
